name: Glob
prose: Filename and path matching only. node_modules and .git always skipped. An accidental .magentra match would spend the user's context on session transcripts and worktree checkouts. Capped at 1000 with a truncation notice; an empty result is not an error.
invariant: Glob keeps .magentra out of results unless the pattern or path names it, matched on a path SEGMENT, and orders by mtime descending.
